items.title: Make Hot Context and latest-audit selection reproducible across fresh checkouts.
items.why: The exact recovered commit fails CI because Hot Context derives generatedAt from filesystem mtimes, which change on checkout. The generator also pins docs/AUDIT_2026-08-03.json while a newer sidecar exists, and the shared local selector itself sorts by mtime.
items.recipe: Make audit-sidecar ordering semantic and deterministic by filename date/ordinal with session metadata as a tie-breaker. Have Hot Context consume that selector, derive its evidence stamp from source content rather than mtimes, and test identical output under perturbed mtimes plus selection of same-day suffixed audits.
items.verificationPremise: Studio Oracle evidence-found (10 lines); GitHub Actions run 30955047803 proves the checkout-only failure at 978/979.

L1.recipe: Remove mtime from Hot Context generatedAt.

L2.recipe: Use deterministic latest-audit selection and add fresh-checkout fixtures.

L3.recipe: Add mtime-perturbation, same-day suffix, stale-audit, and byte-identical regeneration courts.

items.title: Publish what replay evidence actually reproduces—and what it does not.
items.why: The code owns deterministic movement/aim state stepping, a combat slice, and a derived contact-enemy slice, but player and agent surfaces collapse these into one advisory label. That is honest but undersells verified depth and makes the exclusion boundary difficult to inspect.
items.recipe: Create one pure replay-coverage-v1 model sourced from the actual resimulation methods. List covered lanes, excluded dynamics, confidence ceiling, and next verification frontier. Render it in the Trust & Replay panel and project the same contract into gameplay-contract.json, field-manual.json, and agents.json without changing the advisory claim.
items.verificationPremise: Studio Oracle evidence-found (14 lines) across replayResim, MenuPanels, Field Manual, and the public gameplay contract.

L1.recipe: Add a pure coverage/exclusion model with tests.

L2.recipe: Render the model in the player trust panel and human Field Manual.

L3.recipe: Project one source-derived passport to every human/agent surface and add drift/fail-closed courts.

items.title: Align every workflow and local contract on the supported Node runtime.
items.why: All GitHub Actions jobs use Node 20 while the installed Supabase 2.111 graph declares Node 22 or newer. npm ci currently warns and continues, so the unsupported runtime can remain green until an upstream code path breaks.
items.recipe: Declare Node >=22 in package.json, move every setup-node step to Node 22, and add a zero-dependency runtime-contract checker that parses workflow YAML and the installed lockfile engine floor. Wire it into schema:lint so runtime drift cannot silently return.
items.verificationPremise: Studio Oracle evidence-found (22 lines); exact CI logs show six EBADENGINE warnings under Node 20.20.2.

L2.recipe: Declare the package engine and test every workflow occurrence.

L3.recipe: Add a source-derived runtime receipt covering workflows, package engines, and dependency floors, then enforce it in schema lint.

items.title: Separate engineering readiness from SPARKED readiness in one executable receipt.
items.why: launch-readiness reports missing PostHog and Sentry, then calls them post-launch optional, while the canonical handoff records project-scoped telemetry as a SPARKED gate. Its JSON counts assets and owner gates but cannot answer whether engineering staging or public promotion is ready.
items.recipe: Refactor launch-readiness into a pure receipt with engineering and SPARKED rungs, reason-coded gate ownership, required/optional semantics per rung, evidence locations, and next commands. Preserve asset/device/publication distinctions and never read raw env files; capability status must enter as declared/redacted inputs or remain unknown.

L1.recipe: Stop describing missing scoped telemetry as globally optional.

L2.recipe: Emit separate engineeringReady and sparkedReady booleans with reasons.

L3.recipe: Add pure fixtures, redacted capability inputs, evidence receipts, and human output derived from the same model.
